from datetime import datetime

conf = '''# Optimized Logrotate Configuration
# Generated by Log Rotation Analyzer
# Date: {}
#
# This configuration addresses:
# - Missing rotation configs for error.log, debug.log
# - Lack of compression on rotated files
# - Inconsistent retention policies
# - No size-based rotation triggers
#
# Compliance: PCI-DSS, SOX

# Access Log Configuration
# High volume (45.7 MB/day), medium importance
/var/log/samples/access.log {{
    daily
    rotate 14
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    maxsize 100M
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    create 0644 www-data www-data
    sharedscripts
    postrotate
        # Signal nginx to reopen log files
        # /usr/bin/systemctl reload nginx > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
    endscript
}}

# Application Log Configuration
# High volume, medium importance
/var/log/samples/app.log {{
    daily
    rotate 14
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    maxsize 100M
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    create 0644 www-data www-data
    copytruncate
}}

# Error Log Configuration
# Critical importance, SOX compliance requires 60-day retention
/var/log/samples/error.log {{
    daily
    rotate 60
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    maxsize 50M
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    create 0644 www-data www-data
    copytruncate
}}

# Debug Log Configuration
# Low importance, short retention, high volume
/var/log/samples/debug.log {{
    daily
    rotate 7
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    maxsize 50M
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    create 0644 www-data www-data
    copytruncate
}}

# System Log Configuration
# Low volume, standard retention
/var/log/samples/system.log {{
    weekly
    rotate 8
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    maxsize 50M
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    create 0644 root root
}}
'''.format(datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'))

with open('/app/optimized_logrotate.conf', 'w') as f:
    f.write(conf)
print('Logrotate config created')
"
